description: This file implements a class and functions for applying chunking transformations to a Torch FX graph, specifically for models that utilize chunking metadata. It includes methods for categorizing nodes, replacing tangent nodes, chunking inputs, creating accumulators, building subgraphs for chunks, invoking subgraphs, recovering unchunked nodes, and applying the entire transformation pipeline.

classes.name: ChunkingApplier
classes.description: A class that applies chunking transformations to a Torch FX graph, assuming chunking metadata is already attached to nodes. It handles categorizing nodes, replacing tangent nodes, chunking inputs, creating accumulators, building chunked subgraphs, invoking them, recovering original nodes, and applying the entire process.

methods.name: _factory_args
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of tensor properties (device and dtype) for a fake tensor.

methods.name: fake_tensor_prop
methods.description: Performs fake tensor propagation on a GraphModule to infer tensor shapes and properties.

methods.name: is_chunking_subgraph_input
methods.description: Determines if a node is an input to the chunking subgraph based on chunking metadata and node properties.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ChunkingApplier with a GraphModule and number of chunks, reordering nodes and categorizing subgraph nodes.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier._categorize_subgraph_nodes
methods.description: Classifies nodes in the graph as subgraph input, body, or output nodes based on chunking metadata.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.replace_tangent_to_one
methods.description: Replaces tangent nodes with a tensor of ones.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.chunk_subgraph_input
methods.description: Chunks subgraph input nodes if they have chunking metadata.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.create_accumulators
methods.description: Creates accumulator nodes for each output node, using FP32 dtype if necessary.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.build_subgraph
methods.description: Builds a subgraph for a specific chunk size, handling chunked aten.full and aten.expand nodes.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.build_subgraphs
methods.description: Builds subgraphs for all chunk sizes.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.call_subgraph_for_each_chunk
methods.description: Invokes each chunked subgraph for all chunks, collecting outputs.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.recover_to_unchunked_nodes
methods.description: Recovers original nodes from chunks by concatenating or summing, and replaces uses.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.erase_original_nodes
methods.description: Removes original nodes from the graph after chunking.

methods.name: ChunkingApplier.apply
methods.description: Executes the entire chunking transformation pipeline and returns a new GraphModule.
